indicator_owner: [kyle] v1 (ORB; indicator selected in ref_00-40; ORB is a v1 feature per FP-INDICATOR-001)

rules.1_orb_construction: Opening-range box per session: GREEN line = top, BLUE line = midline ('hidden liquidity'), bottom = downside. Acts as support/resistance.
rules.2_first_15_min: YES — the ORB = the first 15 minutes of a session ('15 minutes is full scalp'; transcript 'the first 15 minutes to open' [mis-transcribed '50 minutes']).
rules.3_timezone: Configurable, GMT-based ('depends on the time zone you are in'). Exact GMT+1 per FP-INDICATOR-001 [kyle] v1 dialog.
rules.4_session_times: Three ORBs: Asia, London, New York. Exact times NOT restated here; per FP-INDICATOR-001 v1: Asia 03:00-03:15, London 09:00-09:15, NY 15:30-15:45 (GMT+1).
rules.5_wick_vs_close_break: Emphasis on RETEST; 'lost the orb'=short (close-based); a wick that 'fails to go higher' = fakeout. Candle-close not strictly demanded for the ORB — retest is primary.
rules.6_momentum: Directional momentum implied ('started really bullish, went up'); NO numeric momentum rule.
rules.7_retest: CORE requirement — 'all breakouts retest'; 'wait for retest, take a long'; 'aim for the level'.
rules.8_valid_vs_fakeout: Inside the ORB = choppiness, DON'T trade; outside = trade. Fakeout = fail to hold / double-top then reverse. Blue midline = 'hidden liquidity' inside the ORB.
rules.9_entry_timing: On the RETEST of the ORB top/bottom after the break ('wait for the 15 minutes to open', then break+retest).
rules.11_target: 'Aim for the level' / next level; fast scalp targets.
rules.12_role_of_components: COMBINE: volume candles (direction), POC, VWAP, liquidity; 'break of structure' mentioned once. ORB is the primary structure, confirmed by the others.
rules.13_decision_vs_discretion: Indicator DRAWS the ORB and EMITS buy/sell signals; Farouk applies DISCRETION (session choice, retest, combine, 'I don't trade inside the orb').
rules.14_signal_times: Conflicting: here 'you can do the signal' to adjust time; in FP-INDICATOR-001 'signal times does nothing, I'm going to remove it'. NET: little/no value.
rules.15_alerts_repaint_intrabar_close: Emits buy/sell signals; 'lost the orb' close-based; repaint / alert timing NOT stated -> UNKNOWN.
